falsifier: counterexample satisfying the stated recurrence and initial conditions but not the closed form
evidence: source route lists derivation as stable anchor

label: local quadratic-map fixed-point criterion
falsifier: valid local parameter point violating the stated fixed-point criterion
evidence: source route lists criterion as stable anchor

label: physical BITRAF chip
falsifier: authoritative hardware inspection or reproducible device evidence contradicts claimed implementation
evidence_needed: physical device evidence + measurements + provenance + independent reproduction

label: BITRAF post-quantum security
falsifier: cryptanalytic attack, reduction failure, parameter weakness, or independent review refuting security assumptions
evidence_needed: formal security model + reduction/proof or explicit bounded claim + independent cryptanalysis + test vectors
closure_gate: formal claim scope + reproducible vectors + independent review receipt

label: TAG14 measured error correction
falsifier: measurement set fails predefined error-correction criterion or cannot be reproduced
evidence_needed: protocol + raw measurements + uncertainty + hardware provenance + independent rerun
closure_gate: MEASURED→REPRODUCED with raw-data hash and receipt

label: cosmological BITRAF validation
falsifier: pre-registered statistical comparison rejects the model or shows no support beyond baseline under declared data
evidence_needed: dataset provenance + likelihood/model definition + baseline comparison + reproducible statistical analysis
closure_gate: MEASURED likelihood evidence + reproducible pipeline + comparison receipt

label: biological BITRAF validation
falsifier: controlled experiment or suitable observational analysis fails predefined endpoint or contradicts mechanism
evidence_needed: operational biological hypothesis + ethics-compliant protocol + empirical data + statistical analysis + independent review
closure_gate: ethics gate + MEASURED evidence + independent replication

label: geometric Transformer training
falsifier: declared implementation cannot train/run or controlled benchmark fails predefined criterion
evidence_needed: code pointer + dataset/config hash + run receipt + metrics + baseline
blocking_dependency: authoritative implementation locator and execution receipt

label: Clay problem proof
falsifier: logical counterexample, invalid lemma, unmet problem statement, or expert proof review finding a gap
evidence_needed: complete formal manuscript + dependency-complete lemmas + independent expert verification
blocking_dependency: complete proof and independent proof review
closure_gate: proof-complete artifact + independent validation; computation alone insufficient

label: global universal constant claims
falsifier: one well-specified valid domain counterexample defeats universality
evidence_needed: formal quantified scope + cross-domain evidence + adversarial counterexample search + independent review
closure_gate: explicit quantifiers + exhaustive or theorem-grade support appropriate to claim; no promotion by analogy
